subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publishing, saved browser preferences, and app locale mappings?
rationale: The rename is technically reasonable, but it changes shipped public locale identifiers and compatibility behavior, which automation should not decide without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
options.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require a single migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

options.title: Keep region codes public for now
options.body: Leave `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw's public runtime and CLI IDs while accepting script-form input only as aliases that resolve to the existing IDs.

options.title: Split docs metadata from runtime IDs
options.body: Keep runtime and CLI IDs unchanged while limiting script-based naming to docs publish metadata and navigation internals.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
recommendation.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require a single migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter merged the current CLI onboarding i18n contract and is the best available owner for the cross-surface public locale decision.
